lines.zh: 我小步快走，头一伸一缩。
lines.en: I hurry along in short steps, head darting.
Spooked, I dive into the grass.

lines.zh: 我绕着空地走，避开开阔的地方。
lines.en: I skirt the clearing, avoiding open ground.

lines.zh: 我边走边回头，脖子发紧。
lines.en: I walk and keep looking back, neck taut.
My legs are thin and my tread is light.

lines.zh: 我贴着灌木走，尽量不露。
lines.en: I hug the brush, staying hidden.

lines.zh: 我忽然停住，脖子僵了一下。
lines.en: I stop dead; my neck stiffens.
I move again, faster than before.
I slip along the wall's base.
I thread between the grass blades.

lines.zh: 为躲石头，我绕了一大圈。
lines.en: To avoid a stone, I loop far around it.
I pause to listen every stretch.
I barely move my wings.
I head for wherever there is cover.

lines.zh: 我一边走一边把头压低。
lines.en: I keep my head low as I walk.

lines.zh: 我拐了个急弯，差点绊倒。
lines.en: I take a sharp turn and nearly trip.
I squeeze through a gap in the fence.
I run a few steps, then stop.
I stand, neck rigid.
I am listening, eyes flicking.
My feathers are held tight.

lines.zh: 我一条腿抬着，还没落下。
lines.en: One leg is lifted and has not come down.

lines.zh: 我朝声音的方向偏了偏头。
lines.en: I angle my head toward the sound.
I stand on one leg to rest.
I keep checking both sides.

lines.zh: 我抖了一下，羽毛松开又绷紧。
lines.en: I twitch; feathers loosen and tighten.
I stand low to the ground.
I am always ready to run.
A leaf moves and I tense.
I draw my head down a little.

lines.zh: 我在等一个安全的时刻。
lines.en: I wait for a safe moment.
My breathing is too shallow to hear.
I check behind me again.
I lift a foot and shift my stance.
I see you and freeze.

lines.zh: 我不动，希望你也没看见我。
lines.en: I hold still, hoping you did not see me.

lines.zh: 你一抬手，我就退了一步。
lines.en: You raise a hand; I step back.
I crane my neck to size you up.
I edge toward the grass.
My head turns aside, my eye fixed.
You are not like the usual things.
I lean forward, ready to bolt.
I give one short cry.
You step back; I relax slightly.

lines.zh: 我又看了一眼身后的路。
lines.en: I check the path behind me again.
I take one step the other way.
I shriek and spring away.
Feathers on one side are a mess.
I hit the wall and go over.
I crouch in a grass hollow, shivering.
In my flight I knock the grass flat.
I can barely catch my breath.
I dash into a narrow dirt gap.
My legs give and I stagger.
I tuck my neck down into my wings.
I run a few more steps before stopping.

lines.zh: 我看见了，但我不敢过去。
lines.en: I see it, but I dare not approach.

lines.zh: 我往前走半步，又退回来。
lines.en: I take half a step, then retreat.
I stretch my neck to sniff.

lines.zh: 这味道让我放松了一点。
lines.en: That smell eases me a little.
I peck once, quickly.
Then I back away.
I take half a step, then shrink back into the grass.
If you speak, I bolt.
I want more, but I want safety more.
I bolt away, then circle back.
I carry it into the grass.
I eat and look up between bites.
This will hold me a while.
I come back and stand nearer.

lines.zh: 我吃完把嘴在土上擦了擦。
lines.en: When done, I wipe my bill on the soil.
One sound and I stop eating.
You touch me; I burst away.
I hit the wall and tumble.
I retreat to the corner and shrink.

lines.zh: 你的脚碰过来，我跳到一边。
lines.en: Your foot comes near; I spring aside.

lines.zh: 我撞上你，羽毛撒了一地。
lines.en: I hit you and feathers scatter everywhere.
I run two steps pressed to the ground.
I stop and look back.

lines.zh: 我又撞了一下，这次撞在你腿上。
lines.en: I bump again. Your leg this time.
I dart between your legs.
I hide behind the brush.
Another is at the edge of the grass too.
We stay close, very lightly.
I touch its neck.
It does not dodge aside.
We walk into the brush together.
Its steps are as hurried as mine.

lines.zh: 我们挨着站着，都在看外面。
lines.en: We stand close, both watching outward.

lines.zh: 它叫了一声，我应了一下。
lines.en: It calls; I answer once.

lines.zh: 我们挤在同一个草窝里。
lines.en: We crowd into the same grass nest.

lines.zh: 我们一起跑进更深的草里。
lines.en: We run into deeper grass together.
I snatch it up quickly.

lines.zh: 我把它放在地上，用嘴碰。
lines.en: I set it down and touch it with my bill.
I peck once and back off.
I snatch it up and sprint into the grass.
Not food. I let go.
I run in circles with it in my beak.

lines.zh: 我掉了一次，吓了自己一跳。
lines.en: I drop it and startle myself.
I hide it under a root.
I look a long while before approaching.
I drop it and run.
A rustle in the grass sets me rigid.
I flatten at once.
My neck has drawn back.
I check the nearest grass.
I begin backing away.
I have your direction.
I do not plan to let you close.
I break into a run.
I run and listen at once.
I head for the wall's base.
I trace tight circles on the grass.
The moment you close in, I change direction.
I hit the fence.
I run where the grass is thicker.
I keep listening for you.
I am fast, and my direction is a mess.
I push in among the grass roots.
I break out and change direction.
My beak hangs open and my wings tremble.
I do not stop.
I peck in a panic.
I kick at you.
I flap my wings and batter you.

lines.zh: 我撞在你身上，自己弹开。
lines.en: I hit you and bounce off.
That touches nothing.

lines.zh: 我一直往后退，一边退一边拍。
lines.en: I keep backing and beating my wings.
I peck a stone.
I crash into the door frame.
I shoot past your feet.
I turn and run far off.
I open my eyes and listen first.
I shrink into the nearest grass at once.
This place is too open.
I slowly put my head out.
I move toward somewhere darker.
I walk while watching behind me.
I can hear my own heart.
The grass sways, and I rise up.
I find a grass nest.
I start working along the edge.
Startled, I fall back two steps.
I put my head out again.
The fire frightens me into the fence.
I hit the ground and tumble.
Water closes over me and I flail.

lines.zh: 爆炸声把我震得跳起来。
lines.en: The blast knocks me into the air.
The arrow shears off a few of my flight feathers.
That light is too bright to bear.
Too hungry to run more than two steps.
At the thunderclap I trip over my own feet.
Below is empty. I fall.
